Business HighlightsTransactions (TC) fell notably vs. last year (YoY) on softer dining demand in both citiesProduct-mix adjustment, healthier launches & promotions lifted average check (AC) and gross marginAverage gross margin reached 67% (budget 65%), up MoM since early July
Product UpdatesSZ — Dubai Chocolate Soft Cookie (self-developed, produced in-store): the year's hero product (S1, #1 seller).SZ — Low-calorie line launched Aug 10: 3 half-sugar mini cakes + 3 ciabatta open sandwiches.Half-sugar cakes: D-allulose (a natural sweetener) replaces white sugar — sugar ~50% lower.Ciabatta range adds quality protein & dietary fiber to the meal-period menu.SH — Jul: 23 new products, cheese/dairy most popular; Cranberry Cream Cheese & Fig Cream Cheese Euro Breads in S-class.SH — ¥16 breakfast set: options from 15 to 22; daily sales +14 sets/day.SH — Croissant upgrade: new recipe & process confirmed (Rondo line validated).
